acceptance: AE22 (assertion-verified build/publication) + BC15/BC16/BC17/BC24 closure with generation/identity reports

behavior_contracts.P15.1/gate: build runs check, private assert staging, supervised execution of every required root in stable order, production staging, TS/import validation, input revalidation and atomic current selection. Any failure exits nonzero and leaves production current unchanged; assert-only staging never becomes current.
behavior_contracts.P15.1/roots: Every program assertion verifies, including locked-dependency, native and wrapper roots; build takes no root selector and keeps no verification-result cache, so selected-root success or a cached pass cannot substitute.
behavior_contracts.P15.1/report: Successful builds report input identities (source/dependencies/catalogue/compiler/runtime/options), root totals, evidence labels, the deadline policy and verified status. Selected assert runs report partial scope and never publish.
behavior_contracts.P15.1/timeout: --assert-timeout-ms 1..600000 on build and assert, default 5000; no skip/disabled-deadline flag exists. Timeouts, crashes, isolation/reaping failures and late passes fail verification.
behavior_contracts.P15.1/production: The production entry is never executed during verification; builds issue no live traffic. Published generations ship no assertions tree or runner import; shared context helpers are inert without an assertion context (withFixture passthrough, denyLiveBoundary no-op, live transport proceeds).

bundle: staged per-test distributions via distribution.Build (pinned Bun 1.4.2 archive .local-deps/bun-darwin-aarch64.zip)
changes: driver (commands.go): build() runs the full P15.1 pipeline and summarizes with every-root-required semantics (bounded failing-root labels); shared RunSupervised supervisor from LF04.
driver (assert.go): optional package/[declaration/]name selector runs exactly one root and reports scope partial; full runs report full; assert stages test generations only and never selects current.
driver (output.go): SelectCurrent revalidates the captured snapshot (ensureFresh reload+compare) immediately before atomic current.json selection; DiscardGeneration refuses the published current.
driver (run.go): run verifies through the same build pipeline under the default budget before executing the leased generation.
compiler (main.go): build [--assert-timeout-ms 1..600000] and assert [--assert-timeout-ms 1..600000] [selector]; no verify-skip, no build selector, no unlimited deadline.

tests (verified_build_test.go): G2 passing build (identities/totals/policy/execution), G1 wrong-assertion rejection with no current, failing-rebuild current stability + leased generation integrity, assert nonpublishing (passing/selected/failing) + partial scope, pending-root timeout block, missing native coverage check failure, sticky unused-row violation block, zero-live-request build + one-request run, locked-vendor 4-root graph build/run with wrong-vendor-assertion rejection, production purity (no assertions tree/runner import).

tests (fallout): fetch header-mutation restaging preserves the staged credential; stripStagedAuthorization restages authless raw-provider builds (generation/judge/questions); questions confidence-fallback restages lowered answers; two-stage followup uses a match-call when-row plus an exactly-compared fixture; handler-fault/partial-record/startup-fault cases assert gate rejection with no launch and no redispatch; source-maps main drops incidental unstaged IO (span mapping unchanged).

exit_mapping.AE22-before-after: cli-results.json preserves the G1 before-result (failing-assertion build exit 0); the same frozen project now exits nonzero with no current, and the passing project publishes (verified-build G1/G2 sections).
exit_mapping.AE22-successful: Locked-vendor graph builds with 4/4 roots verified, publishes the reported generation and runs it; selected assert reports partial scope.
exit_mapping.AE22-rejected: Wrong assertions (app + vendor), pending timeout, missing native coverage, null-exchange-only coverage (check TestRawFixtureBindingRejects), sticky unused rows, invalid TS/imports (TestPackagedOutputValidationAndExecution), stale digests and mid-verification edits (Rechecks tests) each fail at their stage.
exit_mapping.AE22-runtime: Stage order check, test staging, supervision, production staging/validation, revalidation, atomic selection; per-stage failure attribution covered; interruption tests preserve one complete verified generation; leases keep old readers intact; builds issue no live requests and never execute live main.
exit_mapping.AE22-fixture: Fixture-only edits change lock/build identity (LF14 + TestBuildInputsChangeOnFixtureOnlyDependencyEdit); workers use captured bytes with fake env; assert staging never becomes current; sticky violations block publication.
exit_mapping.BC15: Failing root, pending race and timeout/crash/isolation judgments fail finite with diagnostics and no publication (G1, pending-assertion, supervise unit controls).
exit_mapping.BC16: Full graph incl. all dependency roots verifies for build; selected assert is partial and never switches current.
exit_mapping.BC17: Mid-build edits, invalid TS, interrupted publication and leased readers behave (recheck, validation, interruption, lease tests).
exit_mapping.BC24: Missing, null-exchange-only and failure-outcome-only native coverage fails at check; negatives cannot substitute for request/decoder evidence.

focused_tests: go test ./compiler/internal/check/ -run TestRawFixture -> pass incl. BC24 rejects (LF15-check.log)
go test ./... -> 15 ok; only known pre-existing TestCoreConsumerSpecification docs-drift panic (LF15-gotest.log)
integration: Staged suite-wide verification: every run/build path verifies before launch or publication; live servers prove zero build-time requests and exact run-time counts; strict tsc validates generated entries; leased generations survive failing rebuilds.
negative: Wrong app/vendor assertions, pending timeout, missing/null-only native coverage, sticky unused rows, invalid TS/imports, stale digests, mid-verification edits, worker crash/timeout/isolation failures: all exit nonzero with current unchanged.
No skip-verify, build-selector or disabled-deadline flag exists; the driver keeps no verification-result cache.
Fault-inject interruption leaves either the old complete generation or the fully verified new one; readers retain leases.
positive: Passing single-project and locked-vendor-graph builds publish one complete verified generation with identities, totals and deadline policy; the artifact executes with the reported output.
Selected assert runs report partial scope; passing, selected and failing asserts never move current.
Production generations ship no assertions tree or runner import; verification issues no live traffic and never executes live main.
